paite: Gilead mi Jephthah mihat hangsan ahi a, kizuaknu tapa ahi. Gilead in Jephthah asuang hi.
heading: Jephthah Sapkikna
english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor. He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead became the father of Jephthah.

paite: Gilead zi in tapate asuansak a; azi tapate ahong pichin un Jephthah adelhkhia ua, akiang ah, "Nang zaw ka pa uh inn ah gou na luah thei kei ding. Numei tuam khat tapa na hih ziak in," achi uhi.
english: Gilead’s wife bore him sons. When his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, “You will not inherit in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman.”

paite: Huchi in Jephthah a-unaute a pan ataimang a, Tob gam ah ateng hi. Jephthah kiang ah mithulim lou pipi atengkhawm ua, amah azui zel uh.
english: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.

paite: Huai nung deuh in Ammon suante'n Israelte adouta uhi.
english: After a while, the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ammon suante'n Israelte adou uleh, Gilead upate Tob gam a Jephthah pi ding in apaikheta uhi.
english: When the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah out of the land of Tob.

paite: Jephthah kiang ah, "Ammon suante ka dou theihna ding un ka heutupen ding un hong om in," achi uhi.
english: They said to Jephthah, “Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.”

paite: Jephthah in Gilead upate kiang ah, "N'on hua ua, ka pa inn a pan na hon delhkhia uh ahi kei maw? Bang achia na buaitak ua ka kiang a hong na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “Didn’t you hate me, and drive me out of my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?”

paite: Gilead upate'n Jephthah kiang ah, "Huaiziaktak ahi, tua nang lam ka hong ngat nawn uh. Ammon suante dou dia ka kiang ua na paitheihna ding in; Gilead gam a teng tengtengte tung ah ka heutu ding un na om ding," achi uhi.
english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Therefore we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight with the children of Ammon. You will be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

paite: Jephthah in Gilead upate kiang ah, "Ammon suante dou dia na hon pikik nawn ua, TOUPA'N amau ahon piakleh na heutu ding un maw ka om ding?" achi hi.
english: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, “If you bring me home again to fight with the children of Ammon, and Yahweh delivers them before me, will I be your head?”

paite: Gilead upate'n Jephthah kiang ah, "Na thu bangbang a ka hih kei uleh i kikal uah hon theihpihpa TOUPA ahi ding,” achi uhi.
english: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Yahweh will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”

paite: Huchi in Jephthah bel Gilead upate kiang ah ahohta a, mite'n heutu ding leh api penpen ding in ana bawlta uhi. Jephthah in Mizpah ah TOUPA ma ah athu teng agenta hi.
english: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them. Jephthah spoke all his words before Yahweh in Mizpah.

paite: Jephthah in Ammon suante kumpipa kiang ah, "Bangchidan a hichibang a ka gam hong dou dia ka kiang a hong pai mawk na hia?" chi in palai asawl hi.
english: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, “What do you have to do with me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?”

paite: Ammon suante kumpipa'n, "Israelte Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt lai ua, ka gam ahon laksak ziak uh ahi. Arnon a pan Jabok leh Jordan tan in. Huaiziak in huai gamte lungdam in hon pe nawn mai in," chi in Jephthah palaite ana dawng hi.
english: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”

paite: Huchi in Jephthah in Ammon suante kumpipa kiang ah palai asawl nawn hi.
english: Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;

paite: Akiang ah, Jephthah in hichi in achi, “Israelte'n Moab gam alaksak kei ua, Ammon suante gam leng alaksak sam kei uh.
english: and he said to him, “Jephthah says: Israel didn’t take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon;

paite: Himahleh, Aigupta gam a pan Israelte ahong pawt un gamdai tawn in Tuipi San ahong tung ua, huai a pan Kadesh ah ahong pai uhi.
english: but when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,

paite: Israelte'n Edom kumpipa kiang ah, 'Hehpih in na gam ah ka paisuak ding uh,' chi in palai asawl uh. Himahleh Edom kumpipa in ana ngaikhe nuam kei. Huchi mah bang in Moab kumpipa kiang ah asawl nawn a, himahleh pha ana sa kei hi. Huchi in Kadesh ah Israelte a-omta uhi.
english: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let me pass through your land;’ but the king of Edom didn’t listen. In the same way, he sent to the king of Moab, but he refused; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.

paite: Huchi in gamdai ah apaisuak ua, Edom gam leh Moab gam kimvel in apai ua, Moab gam suahlam pang ah apai ua, Arnon lehlam pang ah giahphual asat uhi. Moab gamsung ah alut kei hial uh; Arnon bel Moab gamgi chiang ahi.
english: Then they went through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they encamped on the other side of the Arnon; but they didn’t come within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.

paite: Israelte'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon leh Heshbon kumpipa kiang ah palai asawl uhi. Israelte'n akiang ah, ka hong thum uhi, 'Ka mun ua ka paina ding un hehpih in na gam tawn in hon paisuaksak in,' achi uhi.
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to my place.’

paite: Himahleh Sihon in Israelte agam a paisuak ding in amuangzou kei. Sihon in ami tengteng akaikhawm a, Jahaz ah akikulh a, Israelte adouta hi.
english: But Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

paite: TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in Sihon leh ami tengteng Israelte khut ah apia a, amaute athat uhi. Huchi in Israelte'n huai gam a om Amorte gam tengteng atangta uhi.
english: Yahweh, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

paite: Huchi in Amorte gamgi chiang tengteng Arnon a pan Jabok pha in, gamdai a pan Jordan pha in atangvekta uhi.
english: They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in ami Israelte ma ah Amorte ahawlkhia a, bangziak a nang hiai gam luah thei ding na hia?
english: So now Yahweh, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and should you possess them?

paite: Na pathian Kemos in nang a tuam dia ahon sehsaksa tang ding hilou na hi maw? Huchi in TOUPA ka Pathian un ka ma ua ahawlkhiakte uh ka tang ding uhi.
english: Won’t you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whoever Yahweh our God has dispossessed from before us, them will we possess.

paite: Moab kumpipa Zippor tapa Balak sang in na hatzaw a hia? Ama'n Israelte kinakpih in ahihkeileh adou ngei himhim a hia?
english: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?

paite: Heshbon leh akhotate, Aroer leh akhotate, Arnon gamgi naih khopi tengteng a kum zathum tak aten lai ua, bangziak a nang ana lakik lou nilouh na hia?
english: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years! Why didn’t you recover them within that time?

paite: Huaiziak in na tung ah thil bangmah ka hihkhial kei. Nangma'n hon dou na tup ziak in ka tung ah thil na hihkhial ahi zaw. TOUPA, Vaihawmpa in tuni in Israel suante leh Ammon suante kal ah thu ngaihtuah hen," achi hi.
english: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. May Yahweh the Judge be judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.”

paite: Himahleh Ammon suante kumpipa'n Jephthah thukhah ana ngaikhe nuam kei hi.
english: However, the king of the children of Ammon didn’t listen to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

paite: Huchi in Jephthah tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, Gilead leh Manasseh gam ah apaisuak a, Gilead a Mizpah ah apaisuak a, Gilead gam Mizpah a pan Ammon suante kiang ah apai zel hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s Spirit came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah Jephthah akichiam a, "Ammon suante ka khut a na hon piakleh,
english: Jephthah vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,

paite: hichi ahi ding a, Ammon suante a pan galmuang a ka paikik nawn chiang in bangpeuh ka inn kongpi a pan hon dawn masa penpen TOUPA a ahi dia, halmang thillat ding in ka zang ngeingei ding,” achi hi.
english: then it shall be, that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, it shall be Yahweh’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.”

paite: Huchi in Jephthah bel Ammon suante dou ding in akuanta hi. TOUPA'N akhut ah amaute apeta hi.
english: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and Yahweh delivered them into his hand.

paite: Aroer a pan Minnith pha leh Abel-keramim kal a khopi sawmnih azou vek a, mi tampi athat hi. Huchi in Israel suante'n Ammon suante anuaisiahta uhi.
english: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

paite: Jephthah, atenna khua Mizpah a a-inn ah apai a, ngai in, atanu in khuangtate toh lam in ana dawn hi. Ata neihsun ahi a; amah lou tapa hiam tanu dang himhim anei kei hi.
heading: Jephthah Tanu
english: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah amuhtak in apuante abotkek a, "Ehe, ka tanu! N'on niamkiaksak mahmah ve. Hon mangbangsak mite lak a khat na hita. TOUPA ma ah lah ka kam ka na kata ngal a, huai lah zukkik thei ka hita kei," achi hi.
english: When he saw her, he tore his clothes, and said, “Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you are one of those who trouble me; for I have opened my mouth to Yahweh, and I can’t go back.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Pa aw, TOUPA kiang a thu na chiam tak ahihleh, na kam a thupawt bang in ka tung ah hih in. TOUPA'N lah na melma Ammon suante tung ah na phu ahon laksakta ngal a," achi hi.
english: She said to him, “My father, you have opened your mouth to Yahweh; do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth, because Yahweh has taken vengeance for you on your enemies, even on the children of Ammon.”

paite: Ama'n apa kiang ah, "Hichibang in kei a ding in kihih hen. Kha nih sung ka tang-om dia, tangte ah asuk atou in ka pai dia, ka nungak siangthou hihna ka suun ding, kei leh ka lawmte'n," achi hi.
english: Then she said to her father, “Let this thing be done for me. Leave me alone two months, that I may depart and go down on the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.”

paite: Ama'n, "Pai ve," achi hi. Huchi in kha nih taam ding in asawlkhia a; apawt a, amah leh alawmte'n tangte ah anungak siangthou hihna ava suun uhi.
english: He said, “Go.” He sent her away for two months; and she departed, she and her companions, and mourned her virginity on the mountains.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kha nih nung in apa kiang ah ahong kik nawn a, ama'n ana kichiamsa bang in atung ah ahih hi. Atanu nungak siangthou in a-omdenta a, pasal toh alumkhawm ngei kei hi.
english: At the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed. She was a virgin. It became a custom in Israel

paite: Israel tanute'n Gilead mi Jephthah tanu kum teng in ni li sung asuun zel uhi. Hiai Israelte lak ah ngeina in aneita uhi.
english: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to celebrate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
